verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents that once you configure an embedder it automatically generates vector embeddings for every document, so you never compute or manage them yourself, and it stores them for semantic and hybrid search. A community report about HuggingFace's Meilisearch-backed endpoint, where a maintainer attributed latency to waiting on OpenAI embeddings, corroborates that the engine itself calls a managed embedding provider at query time. Missing for 10: documentation of which built-in or managed embedder providers are supported, explicit first-party confirmation that queries are auto-vectorized, and in-depth configuration docs.
